description: This file defines an ASP.NET Core MVC action filter that validates the model state before executing an action. If validation fails, it returns a JSON response with validation errors and a 422 status code.

classes.name: ValidatorActionFilter
classes.description: An implementation of IActionFilter that validates the model state before action execution and returns validation errors as JSON if invalid.

methods.name: OnActionExecuting
methods.description: Checks if the model state is valid; if not, constructs and returns a JSON-formatted error response with status code 422.

methods.name: OnActionExecuted
methods.description: Empty implementation of IActionFilter method, placeholder for post-action logic.
